# Mary Joe

## Overview

- **Origin:** the creek  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Mary Joe is a young French woman from the creek. She is characterized physically by a buxom build and a broad face.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P28](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0028)_

## History

Mary Joe was hired by the [Barry](../character/barry.md) family as a French girl to care for [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) and [Diana](../character/diana.md) while their parents were away in [Charlottetown](../codex/places.md#charlottetown). When [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) fell dangerously ill with croup, Mary Joe became terrified and was unable to handle the situation, prompting [Diana](../character/diana.md) to run to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for help. Once [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) arrived, Mary Joe followed her instructions by keeping a fire burning and heating water until [Minnie](../character/minnie.md) May's condition improved.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P3](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0003), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P4](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0004), [v1 CHAPTER XVIII.
